COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
22.11.2021 WPSS No. 657 of 2021
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mrs. Neetu Singh, Advocate, for the
petitioner.
Mr. Narayan Dutt, Brief Holder, for the
State.
Mr. Lalit Samant, Advocate, for the
respondent(s).
This writ petition was disposed of by
this Court, by an order dated 16.06.2021. The
same has been sought to be modified by the
respondents by filing a Modification
Application (MCC/3/2021), seeking extension
of time to comply with the directions given
therein for the purposes of remittance of
gratuity, leave encashment and medical
reimbursement.
This Court is of the view that the retiral
benefits payable to the retired employee is one
of the source of his/her surviving and since the
time period for its compliance has expired, no
extension as such could be granted under the
garb of modification application, hence the
application is misconceived and the same is
accordingly rejected.
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 22.11.2021 Mahinder/
